Wood Log

Back to materials database

Cutting trees yields Wood Logs. Official 0.8.10.871 notes say normal wood gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase; respawn timing is unverified.

When you need it

Keep Wood Logs for early construction before testing the community charcoal lead; the retained evidence does not establish a universal recipe list.

Sources and evidence

  • Current community reports obtain Wood Logs by cutting trees; the retained reports do not establish tree respawn timing or ownership rules. Community-confirmed

    Source: August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Official 0.8.10.871 notes say normal wood and stone gathering outside the ranch does not trigger a police chase. The 0.8.10.868 notes describe this as temporary while dedicated gathering areas are developed; this does not establish rules for taking loose items or every ownership interaction. Official

    Source: Official update 0.8.10.871: gathering wood and stone outside the ranch · Official update 0.8.10.868: temporary Trees & Rocks change · Build: 0.8.10.871; temporary change introduced in 0.8.10.868

  • Launch-build footage shows a Red Tent recipe requiring 10 Wood Logs and 8 Stone; it does not prove other recipe costs. Video-observed

    Source: Games Station gameplay footage: Red Tent recipe at 71:40 · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.455
